\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows}

\makeatletter
\pgfarrowsdeclare{map tick}{map tick}{
  \pgfarrowsleftextend{-.8pt}
  \pgfarrowsrightextend{1.2pt}
}{
  \pgfsetroundcap
  \pgfpathmoveto{\pgfqpoint{-.8pt}{-1.2pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{1.2pt}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{-.8pt}{1.2pt}}
  \pgfusepathqstroke
}
\pgfarrowsdeclaredouble[.8pt]{double map}{double map}{map tick}{map tick}
\pgfarrowsdeclaretriple[\pgflinewidth]{triple map}{triple map}{map tick}{map tick}
\makeatother

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \node (a) at (0,1.2) {$A$};
  \node (b) at (5,1.2) {$B$};
  \node (x) at (0,0) {$x$};
  \node (y) at (5,0) {$f(x)$};
  \draw[blue!70!black,line width=.8pt,-{double map}] (a) to[bend left=15] node[above] {$f$} (b);
  \draw[purple!80!black,line width=1.2pt,-{triple map}] (x) -- node[above] {$f\circ f\circ f$} (y);
  \draw[gray!70,line width=.8pt,{double map}-{triple map}] (a) -- (x);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
